radix4_compute.selection_basis: Optimized reconstruction with a conflict-free shared layout, vector loads/stores, and 21 invariant coefficient pairs prepared once per kernel launch before repetition. The difference-based timing excludes coefficient preparation; this does not recover the original paper source or its 0.0120 ms experiment.

register_branch.selection_basis: Selected artifact source for the approximately 0.0079 ms reduced-communication row; exact original-paper identity remains unconfirmed.

candidate_implementations.title: Optimized reconstructed radix-4 FFT with shared-memory exchange and cached coefficients
candidate_implementations.source_selection_basis: New reconstruction using a conflict-free shared layout, vector loads/stores at every radix-4 stage, and 21 coefficient pairs cached per launch before repetition; no register-stage permutation. Difference-based timing excludes coefficient preparation. Identified by source SHA-256, not a recovered historical commit.
